task.description:
Rework design artefact src/design/agt05-07-design.md per CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gaps:

GAP-1 (MAJOR): The migration is named 1172_agt06_artifact_retention.sql but migration 1172 already exists (SBX-04/05/06). Update all three references in the design to use migration number 1173: → 1173_agt06_artifact_retention.sql

GAP-2 (MINOR): In the AGT-05 section, add one sentence stating: 'AC4 is satisfied by the existing spec_hash guard in handleArtifactSubmit (AGT-04) — when an artifact is submitted with a spec_hash computed without rng_seed, the stored spec_hash (which includes rng_seed) differs, so the guard returns HTTP 409 spec_hash_mismatch.'

GAP-3 (MINOR): In the AGT-05 section, add a note for AC5: 'AC5 (replay uses stored rng_seed) is a SIM-01 concern and out of scope for this implementation unit. task_specs.rng_seed persists the seed for replay; the replay module (SIM-01) is responsible for reading it.'

No other changes. Return PASS.

result.summary: Rework complete: migration number updated 1172→1173 (3 references), AC4 traceability sentence added to AGT-05, AC5 SIM-01 scoping note added to AGT-05.
